title: Staff Product Marketing Manager - Netherlands Market 🇳🇱
description:
Our mission and customers: We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.8 on Trustpilot, based on 55,000+ reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do, as proven by our Net Promoter Score of 75 (more about our culture here).
Our journey: Founded in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,600+ Qontoers serving over 600,000+ customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.
Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.
AI at Qonto: AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Mission
Join Qonto as Staff Product Marketing Manager for the Netherlands to take a young, high-potential market to its next stage of growth. The basics are in place: localized IBANs, accounting integrations and payment methods, and a product that's already found real fit with Dutch freelancers and SMEs.
You'll work closely with Paula Ibarra, your future manager, and Georg Nuechtern, our NL Managing Director, and you'll be part of a PMM team dedicated to making Qonto the daily finance workspace for freelancer and SMEs across Europe.
➡️ As a Staff Product Marketing Manager at Qonto, you will
Close the gap between market perception and product reality: Dutch customers and competitors talk about features Qonto may already ship. Part of this role is knowing the product cold enough to catch that gap before it becomes a lost deal or a wrong roadmap bet.
Own the go-to-market for the Netherlands: Lead GTM end to end for a pipeline of upcoming pricing and product launches.
Be the voice of the Dutch market internally: Spend time with customers and prospects, understand which local gaps remain despite already-strong product-market fit, and turn that into prioritized input for the roadmap.
Partner cross-functionally at speed: Work inside a tribe that moves fast, run in close collaboration with Product and Tech. Bring that same collaboration to ongoing pricing experiments and acquisition partnerships.
Take ownership of measurable impact: Define success metrics for your initiatives and own their effect on activation, adoption, and revenue, building on a team that has hit its targets quarter after quarter.
➡️ What to expect
Strategic market focus: The role is built around the Netherlands specifically, at an early stage of the market's life. You're joining a team that launched a year ago and was staffed within the last year.
Fast, test-driven culture: The team runs as a tribe, Lean-inspired, agile, constantly experimenting on pricing, incentives, and acquisition.
Competitive market: You'll be up against traditional Dutch banks pushing further online and after freelancers and solopreneurs, strong local neobanks, payment pure players, and non-Dutch entrants building presence through social and money transfer products.
High impact, high visibility: A strategic, multifaceted role with a strong business focus, positioning you as a true partner to the market's leadership.
Growth environment: You're joining an early-stage market with real traction and headroom, as Qonto pushes to become the daily finance workspace for SMEs, with ambitious OKRs for 2026.
➡️ About you
Fintech and market experience: Strong market and business acumen in B2B fintech or adjacent markets, ideally including firsthand knowledge of the Dutch competitive landscape.

title: Senior Forward Deployed Scientist
description: Life at UiPath The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power. To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care-about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose. Could that be you? Your mission This is one of the most exciting problems in applied AI right now: take the cutting edge of machine learning, optimisation, and agentic systems, and make it work inside real businesses - not in a lab, but on live customer problems where the answer has to hold up commercially. As a Senior Forward Deployed Scientist in our Supply Chain & Retail business, you’ll work directly with some of the world’s biggest retailers and manufacturers on hard, high-stakes problems: demand forecasting, price and promotion optimisation, and supply-chain decisioning. You’ll own the science end-to-end - from understanding a customer’s messy reality to shipping something that changes how they operate. And you won’t just deliver. What you learn on the front line feeds directly back into the products we build, so you’re shaping the capability the whole business runs on - not just solving one problem at a time. What you'll do at UiPath Own customer engagements end-to-end - frame the problem, build the solution, and drive it to real commercial impact, working directly alongside customer teams.

title: Customer Engineer
description:
At Render, we’re building the modern cloud platform for developers creating AI-native, full-stack, multi-service applications. Our mission is to eliminate the tradeoff between the power of hyperscalers and the simplicity of developer-friendly platforms-so teams can ship fast, scale reliably, and focus on their product, not infrastructure.

Unlike complex hyperscalers or ephemeral edge/serverless solutions, Render offers a developer-first experience with persistent compute, dynamic autoscaling, built-in orchestration, and observability, allowing teams to launch, scale, and manage real-world applications without writing infrastructure code or managing servers. Whether you're building LLM-powered applications, scalable SaaS products, or async processing pipelines, Render empowers teams to move fast and scale confidently from MVP to millions of users.

Our platform is trusted by over 7 million developers worldwide and continues to grow rapidly. In February 2026, we raised an additional $100M in Series C financing, bringing our total funding to $260M, to accelerate our vision of making cloud infrastructure both powerful and intuitive-designed for the speed of modern AI development.

We’re a diverse and talented team that values craft, velocity, and user experience. If you’re excited to help shape the future of the intelligent cloud and empower developers everywhere, we’d love to hear from you.

APPLYING TO RENDER

We're seeking candidates who possess high integrity, humility, and an insatiable drive to learn. Through reasoned discussions and continuous feedback, we strive to improve both individually and collectively. We foster an environment of mutual trust and respect, empowering effective debate to achieve the best outcomes for our customers and team.

We especially encourage members of underrepresented groups in the tech community to apply and understand that not all successful candidates will meet each requirement listed.

Our interview process is unique to each role, and we value the candidate experience just as much as our customer experience. We hope your conversations with us reflect a thoughtful process that is illuminative, enjoyable, and respectful of your time.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are hiring the first members of Render's Scaled Programs Customer Engineering team to help run the technical side of our scaled, digital-first customer motion. You'll support high-growth accounts without dedicated technical coverage, including our startup program cohort, through programmatic, one-to-many engagement rather than a traditional one-to-one model. The role has two halves: running scaled programs (in-app engagement, targeted outreach against expansion and churn signals, webinars) and contributing to the tools and content that power the broader Field Engineering organization (health triggers, growth and expansion opportunities based on product usage, pricing and sizing tools, POC templates, and enablement content). You'll partner closely with our Scaled Account Managers and report into Render's Field Engineering organization.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Partner with Scaled AMs and Field Engineering teammates to turn expansion and churn signals (bandwidth, egress, usage patterns) into plays: AM talking points, programmatic outreach, and in-app prompts.

- Operate startup program onboarding: Intercom checklists, guided flows, and activation follow-up for high-growth AI startups.

- Partner with Support Engineering to identify recurring mistakes and best practices, then turn those insights into programs and content that reduce customer friction.

- Build and improve components of our scaled-engagement toolkit: in-app programs, outbound triggers, pricing and sizing calculators (e.g., Heroku and AWS RDS migrations to Postgres), POC templates, and reusable technical enablement.

- Run scaled customer programs: webinars, Slack community touchpoints, and pattern-based outreach across account cohorts, partnered with Scaled AMs.

- Translate recurring

We're hiring a Product Partnerships Manager to own Replit's most important strategic partnerships end-to-end: from identifying the opportunity to shipping the outcome and measuring the impact.

This is a product-focused role where you will work with our consumer technology partners, such as Stripe, Shopify, Google, and the broader connector ecosystem. You'll negotiate with senior partner stakeholders. And you'll be the person accountable for turning ambiguous ecosystem opportunities into shipped product and business outcomes.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Develop a clear point of view on Replit's partner landscape and build a prioritized pipeline of high-leverage opportunities across consumer tooling, AI tooling, cloud and infrastructure, and payments technology partners.

- Lead partner conversations from early exploration through joint product thesis, business case, commercial terms, launch plan, and post-launch iteration.

- Partner with Product, Engineering, Partner Engineering, Legal, Finance, Marketing, and Sales to turn agreements into shipped outcomes.

- Work directly with Partner Engineers to scope integrations, demos, prototypes, reference apps, and partner enablement assets.

- Define success metrics before every launch activation: retained usage, apps created, deployments, revenue, partner-sourced users, and use them to decide when to scale, iterate, or sunset a partnership.

- Build lightweight operating systems: partner scorecards, launch checklists, partner roadmap tracking, and repeatable frameworks for evaluating new opportunities.

- Represent the partner internally with strong product judgment; inform roadmap changes only when they create clear leverage for Replit users.

WHO YOU ARE

You're probably one of these:

- A product partnerships or BD person from a developer platform, AI platform, API company, cloud platform, or builder tool.

- A former PM or founder who can sell and negotiate externally while staying close to the product.

- A technical ecosystem operator who has shipped integrations, partner programs, or AI-native workflows.

In all cases, you're a builder. You can open Replit and put together a credible demo. You're not expected to write production integration code but you need enough technical depth to scope the work, ask the right questions, and earn trust with engineers.

REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

- Experience sourcing, structuring, negotiating, and launching strategic partnerships.

- Strong product judgment: you can explain why a partnership should or shouldn't influence the roadmap.

- Technical fluency with APIs, auth, cloud and deployment, databases, LLMs, agents, and developer workflows.

- Hands-on familiarity with Replit or comparable AI-native developer tools; ability to build credible demos and prototypes.

- Ability to run an ambiguous, multi-party process from discovery through signed agreement, launch, and measurement.

- Credibility with both senior external partners and internal engineers.

- Strong written and verbal communication.

 

BONUS QUALIFICATIONS

- Background in AI, developer tools, cloud infrastructure, API companies, or creative/productivity software.

- Experience with MCP-style integrations, agent workflows, or AI model/tooling ecosystems.

- Founder, PM, DevRel, solutions engineering, or technical BD background

The role
This is not a traditional marketing role, and it is not a pure engineering role either.
You will decide which accounts matter, build the systems that research them, write the content that reaches them, build the partnerships that amplify it, and turn all of that into qualified pipeline.
Two things have to be true about you at once.
You are technically sharp enough to build your own workflows, wire up your own APIs, and ship a working system without waiting on engineering or anyone else. Nothing you own should be blocked on a single person, including us.
And you are obsessed with distribution - content, syndication, social, and partnerships - because pipeline goes to whoever the buyer already trusts. That means newsletters, communities, podcasts, comparison pages, partner audiences, and the people who influence them.

GTM strategy and experimentation

Content and syndication

• Own Oliv's content engine end to end: what gets made, who it is for, where it goes, and what it is supposed to produce. You will write it yourself.

• Build and work a distribution list of newsletters, communities, podcasts, and industry publications, and land Oliv in them.

• Get Oliv into the third-party listicles and comparison pages that both human buyers and AI answer engines cite.

• Build syndication and repurposing as a system, not a manual chore.

• Judge content on pipeline influenced, not on traffic or impressions.

Social and community

• Run Oliv's social presence, brand and founder accounts alike, including ghostwriting for executives.

• Turn engagement into a workable audience: capture the people who interact, enrich them, and route them into the right motion.

• Treat social as a research channel as much as a broadcast one, and feed what you learn back into messaging and targeting.

Partnerships and ecosystem

• Identify, pitch, and land the partners worth having: integration and tech partners, agencies, consultancies, communities, creators, and resellers.

The function covers four capabilities: partner programs, partner operations, channel development, and partner enablement.

title: Software Engineer (C++/Rust)
description:
The financial industry is growing at a record pace, but our data providers are still stuck in the past - with cumbersome onboarding processes, complicated APIs, slow infrastructure, and expensive licensing costs.

Databento is the market data platform for modern finance. The company provides real-time and historical data across futures, options, and equities through a unified API. By owning the entire market data stack end-to-end, Databento is the first platform of its kind to combine the performance and reliability demanded by the world's leading trading firms with a dramatically simpler developer experience. Our team includes alumni of Two Sigma, Citadel Securities, Flow Traders, Tower Research, PDT Partners, SIG, and other top quantitative firms.

We're looking for a midlevel or senior IC to join our core engineering team. Our team is responsible for all things C/C++ and Rust, and the most performance-sensitive parts of our codebase. You'll be working with nearly 20 PB of data, with thousands of bare metal CPU cores at your disposal.

Responsibilities

• Design, develop, and maintain high-performance server applications in C/C++ and Rust.

• Write message parsers and feed handlers for direct market data feeds from trading venues.

• Optimize existing codebase for high throughput (millions of messages per second, up to 40+ gigabits) and low latency (measured in nanoseconds).

• Implement tools and libraries for petabyte-scale data processing and analysis.

• Collaborate with the systems team to implement best practices for build, deployment, CI/CD.

• Implement monitoring and improve application uptime.

• Ensure smooth feature rollouts and updates.

Preferred background

• 5+ years of full-time software engineering experience, preferably at a trading firm, tech company, or high-growth startup.

• Strong proficiency in C/C++ or Rust.

• Knowledge of systems programming, algorithms, data structures, multithreading, networked I/O, serialization, CPU architecture, kernel, and compilers.

• Experience working with multiprocess environments.

• Comfortable with lldb/gdb.

• Good communication skills and work ethic for a remote workplace.

• An interest in low-level optimization and performance engineering.

• An interest in financial data or algorithmic trading.

Notice about phishing scams

Be cautious of phishing scams impersonating Databento that offer fake job interviews and request purchases. Official emails come only from @databento.com or us.greenhouse-mail.io (our ATS). Any other domains (e.g., databento-careers.com, databento.online) are fraudulent.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training. • Integrate with internal systems, financial partners, payment providers, AI services and third-party platforms.

• Good understanding of APIs, databases, authentication, authorization, queues, jobs, events and integrations.

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Philippines . We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Philippines .

We are building a new kind of biotech company, one that maintains its roots as a science-based start-up and pushes our commitment to innovate across all corners of our business. We strive to inspire and grow our company, our partnerships, our science, and our people, because when we do, we deliver more for patients.
The Medical Safety Lead provides strategic medical safety leadership, serving as the single point of contact for all aspects of patient safety. In this role, the Lead is accountable for defining and driving the strategy and approach for communicating safety information across the product(s) lifecycle and projects. Responsibilities include offering expert medical safety contribution and oversight, ensuring comprehensive ownership of safety activities, and leading the assessment of safety data to support informed decision‑making. The role also requires close collaboration with internal stakeholders such as Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Development, and Medical Affairs, as well as external partners including key opinion leaders and regulatory agencies, to align safety communications and ensure the safe and effective use of argenx products.
ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

• Provide strategic medical safety leadership and practical contributions in a cross-functional setting

• Participate in cross-functional strategic planning and meetings

• Lead and contribute to the safety signal management and benefit risk assessment activities as well as other regular and/or ad-hoc aggregate safety data reviews

• Contribute to the development of the overall safety governance structure and activities

• Provide safety strategies and deliver accurate, timely and high quality safety contributions for the preparation of relevant sections of regulatory submission documents globally (e.g. ISS, SCS, responses to regulatory authority inquiries)

• Contribute to and ensure completeness, accuracy and high quality safety sections of clinical documents (including study protocols, IBs, Clinical Study Reports, or ICFs)

• Lead the overall preparation of periodic safety reports (e.g. PSUR, DSUR); provide medical safety content and ensure consistency and quality of these documents

• Perform the medical assessment of individual case safety reports (ICSR) when required

• Provide medical safety contributions at internal audits and regulatory inspections

• Support the development of and updates to GPS Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and other controlled documents (e.g. work instructions, forms, templates)

• Support product(s) safety training and pharmacovigilance awareness activities cross functionally

• Lead the development, maintenance, and execution of Risk Management Plans (RMPs) and Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategies (REMS)

• Contribute actively to the updates of the safety labelling sections and Core Data Sheets (CDS)

• Provide strategic guidance and have oversight on the case processing activities

• Partner with Safety Operations on case quality issues, MedDRA coding, and case processing convention

• Participate in cross-functional projects and initiatives

• Manage safety physicians as required

• Perform other tasks as required to assist in departmental activities

SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES

• Strong ability to lead, motivate, influence, and collaborate with multidisciplinary teams

• Knowledge of pharmacovigilance as applies to safety signal management, safety data review in clinical and post-marketing settings

• Knowledge of relevant global pharmacovigilance regulations and guidelines

title: Intermediate Full-Stack Software Developer

GI is our WHY and for more than 30 years that purpose has driven our scientific rigour, operational excellence, and deep therapeutic expertise, including supporting more than 70% of IBD compounds in development.
We operate as a private, profit-with-purpose company, channeling our commercial success back into scientific research, technology, and our people. The intermediate full-stack developer will be responsible for advancing the software development lifecycle stages from system design to robust implementation, with a specific focus on our Imaging products. The role requires active cross-functional collaboration to deliver complex solutions, and entails greater ownership of design and implementation tasks, an active role in maintenance and support, and a strong focus on documentation and continuous professional growth. Finally, you'll play a key role in the planning and intermediate stages of the project lifecycle, ensuring that development efforts align with departmental objectives.

Application Development and Implementation (40%)

Support (20%)

Continuous Improvement (20%)

Application Documentation (20%)

•
Experience level: Bachelor's degree or Diploma, plus 2-4 years experience in Full-Stack Development:

•
Required: Angular/TypeScript, Node.js or Python, AWS (Lambda, S3, DynamoDB, Cognito, API Gateway), CI/CD, Docker, Git.

•
Preferred: Cornerstone3D or a similar web DICOM viewer library, DICOM, and validated-environment delivery.

description:

- Legal Foundation: JD from an accredited law school and active membership in at least one U.S. state bar

- Commercial Experience: 5-7 years of relevant legal experience supporting enterprise software sales and complex commercial transactions, preferably at high-growth technology companies

- Technology Focus: Strong background in SaaS agreements, software licensing, and technology transactions, with bonus points for experience with AI/ML tools, developer platforms, or cloud infrastructure

- Deal Velocity: Proven track record of successfully closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals in fast-paced environments while balancing legal risk with business objectives

- Business Acumen: Exceptional business judgment and ability to provide practical, solutions-oriented legal advice that enables (rather than blocks) commercial success

- Communication Skills: Outstanding written and verbal communication abilities, with experience presenting to and influencing C-level executives and enterprise customer stakeholders

- Startup DNA: Thrives in ambiguous, rapidly evolving environments where you'll need to build processes from the ground up and adapt quickly to changing priorities

- Collaboration: Collaborative mindset with a track record of building strong cross-functional relationships and supporting high-velocity sales processes

BONUS POINTS IF YOU HAVE

- In-House Experience: Previous in-house counsel experience at technology companies, particularly those serving enterprise customers or developer audiences

- AI/Developer Tools: Experience with AI, machine learning, or developer platf

The Data Movement team is looking to hire a Software Engineer who is excited to solve large scale data platform and efficiency challenges.

If you have a passion for building and maintaining high quality code, want to improve how Reddit makes strategic decisions at the company level, and are excited about applying engineering best practices to one of the most powerful corpus of data in the world, then this is the team for you!

As a Commercial Logistics Representative, Global , you’ll play a critical role in coordinating the timely and accurate movement of spinal implants, instruments, and surgical kits - ensuring products arrive where and when they are needed to support surgical schedules across domestic and international markets.

• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office (especially Excel) and experience with ERP systems (JD Edwards, SAP, or similar preferred)

title: Director, Strategic Growth & Institutional Funding
description:

Prisms VR is a San Francisco-based team of educators, game developers, and engineers transforming K12 STEM education through experiential real-world problem-solving powered by the next generation of spatial computing. We utilize adaptive Virtual Reality (VR) to engage, inspire, and open pathways to creative problem-solving to rapidly improve engagement and proficiencies in Math and Science across our country and beyond. Our mission is to break down barriers to access and build STEM proficiencies at scale for all students, worldwide.

The Director of Strategic Growth & Institutional Funding operates at the critical intersection of business development and institutional funding. Your primary mission is to accelerate revenue growth by identifying, securing, and scaling funding sources that enable K-12 schools and districts to purchase our educational technology solutions. You will blend the persuasive narrative skills of a master grant writer with the commercial acumen of a business development executive to unlock federal, state, and private philanthropic funds.

Key Responsibilities

Grant Strategy & Writing (50%)

•
Draft compelling proposals : Write highly persuasive, compliant, and technically accurate grant applications, concept notes, and RFPs tailored to K-12 buyers.

•
Align product to funding : Translate complex edtech product features into clear, impactful educational outcomes that match the specific goals of grant makers (e.g., Title I, Title II, IDEA, ARP, and private foundations).

•
Build a turnkey toolkit : Create reusable grant toolkits, templates, and boilerplates that district partners can easily use to apply for funding independently to purchase our platform.

•
Monitor compliance : Track post-award reporting requirements and impact metrics to ensure high renewal and retention rates.

Business Development & Market Expansion (50%)

•
Identify funding pipelines : Research, track, and analyze federal, state, and private funding streams to identify new market opportunities for the sales team.

•
Consult with K-12 leaders : Act as an internal funding expert, conducting consultative discovery calls alongside Account Executives to help superintendents and curriculum directors map their strategic budgets to our solutions.

•

•
Enable the sales team : Train the sales and customer success teams on how to leverage specific funding streams to overcome budget objections and shorten sales cycles.

Required Qualifications

•
Experience : 4+ years of combined experience in K-12 grant writing, educational procurement, or edtech business development.

•
Domain Knowledge : Deep understanding of K-12 funding structures, including federal formula funds (ESSA Titles), competitive federal grants, and state-level allocations.

•
Proven Track Record : Demonstrated success in securing six- and seven-figure grants or public sector contracts.

•
Communication : Exceptional writing, editing, and storytelling skills, with the ability to explain complex technical products in simple pedagogical terms.

•
Project Management : Strong organizational skills to manage multiple strict grant deadlines simultaneously.

Preferred Qualifications

• Former experience as a K-12 administrator, district grant coordinator, or educational consultant.

• Familiarity with Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar CRM tools to track funding pipelines.

title: Director of Strategic Philanthropy
company: Big Brothers Big Sisters of America
description:
Position Purpose

The Director of Strategic Philanthropy serves as a frontline fundraiser responsible for identifying, cultivating, soliciting, and stewarding a portfolio of major individual donors in support of Big Brothers Big Sisters of America 's (BBBSA) mission and strategic priorities. Reporting to the VP, Strategic Philanthropy, this role builds meaningful, long-term relationships with donors capable of six and seven-figure gifts, translating BBBSA's impact and strategic priorities into compelling, donor-centered cases for support.

The Director of Strategic Philanthropy partners closely with the Resource Development team, program and agency leaders, and executive staff to develop personalized cultivation strategies, craft gift proposals, and ensure a high-quality donor experience across the giving lifecycle. The role plays a critical part in growing BBBSA's individual giving program and advancing its national fundraising goals.

The ideal candidate is a relationship-driven fundraiser with a track record of closing six and seven- figure gifts, sound judgment, and the ability to manage a dynamic portfolio of prospects and donors in a mission-driven, federated organization.

Location : Continental United States (100% Remote)
FLSA Status: Full Time, Exempt

Travel: Approximately 30%-35% with occasional additional travel as needed.

Remote Work Location Requirement

This position is approved for remote work within the Continental United States only. Any permanent change to the geographic location of an employee's remote work arrangement from the region identified at the time of hire must be reviewed and approved in advance by both the employee's direct manager and Human Resources. Travel of approximately 30-35% is required for donor visits, cultivation events, and organizational meetings.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Portfolio Management

• Manage a portfolio of approximately 100-150 major donors and prospects, with individual gift capacity typically ranging from $25,000 to $100,000+.

• Develop and execute individualized cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship strategies for each donor in the portfolio using a moves management framework.

• Maintain an active pipeline of qualified prospects sufficient to meet annual revenue goals, tracking stage, next steps, and timing for each relationship.

• Document all donor interactions, moves, and strategies in the CRM in a timely and accurate manner to ensure institutional knowledge is preserved and shared.

Prospect Identification & Qualification

• Partner with the prospect research function to identify new major gift prospects through wealth screening, referrals, and relationship mapping.

• Qualify prospects through discovery visits and calls, assessing capacity, affinity, and readiness for solicitation.

• Collaborate with local BBBS agency leaders to identify and cultivate donors with connections to both the national office and local chapters.

Cultivation, Solicitation & Stewardship

• Design and deliver personalized cultivation experiences, including donor visits, briefings, campus and program tours, and executive engagement opportunities.

• Draft compelling, donor-centered gift proposals, briefing materials, and stewardship reports in partnership with the Marketing & Communications and Program teams.

• Directly solicit major gifts, leading or supporting solicitation visits alongside executive leadership, board members, or volunteers as appropriate.

• Ensure timely, accurate gift acknowledgment and develop meaningful stewardship touchpoints that build long-term donor loyalty and encourage renewed and increased giving.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner with the Resource Development team to align major gift strategies with annual fundraising goals, campaign priorities, and organizational strategic plans.

• Work with Marketing & Communications to ensure donor-facing materials reflect current brand standards and effectively communicate BBBSA's impact.

description:
WHO WE ARE

Roboflow is building the visual cortex for AGI.

 

Every day, millions of developers and half of the Fortune 100 use Roboflow to count cells https://blog.roboflow.com/cancer-research-computer-vision/ to accelerate cancer research, improve construction site safety https://blog.roboflow.com/preventing-accidents-on-construction-sites-with-computer-vision/, digitize floor plans https://blog.roboflow.com/floor-plan-analysis-computer-vision/, preserve coral reef populations https://blog.roboflow.com/reefos-supercharging-coral-reef-restoration-with-ai/, guide drone flight https://blog.roboflow.com/georeferencing-drone-videos/, and much more https://roboflow.com/templates.

 

We have built the tools, community, and resources needed to make the world programmable with artificial intelligence. We're supported by great customers and investors, having raised over $100 million from Google Ventures, Craft Ventures, Sam Altman, Lachy Groom, Y Combinator, and more.

 

Roboflow Labs is our applied research unit. We train our own open models (RF-DETR). We build our own benchmarks grounded in real enterprise use cases (RF100-VL). And we partner with frontier labs to deliver the training data they need to advance the capabilities that drive the most value back to our customers.

 

Behind all of it is a global network of millions of Roboflow developers who have annotated billions of images and videos to date, as well as a proven enterprise business that is exploding as AI traverses the physical economy.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

As a Research Scientist at Roboflow Labs, you'll sit at the intersection of our benchmarks, our models, and the researchers at frontier labs who buy our data: running failure analyses that show exactly where a model breaks on real-world tasks, turning those findings into dataset and evaluation specifications, and validating that the data we ship actually moves the numbers. You'll publish, extend RF100-VL and the benchmarks that follow it, and help set the research agenda for a team whose work is grounded in millions of real deployments rather than fabricated test sets.

- Design datasets, evaluations, and RL environments that target measurable gaps in frontier vision-language, multi-modal, robotics, and coding models

- Run structured failure analyses on partner labs' models against Roboflow's real-world task distribution and write the remediation specs that say what data will close each gap

- Own the research behind new benchmarks that we publish.

- Validate data quality empirically - fine-tune, ablate, and measure so that every dataset we sell comes with evidence it works

- Contribute to Roboflow's open models (RF-DETR and successors) and represent Labs within the research community

- Work directly with research scientists at frontier labs as a technical peer, translating their model roadmaps into concrete data programs

WHO YOU ARE

You are a researcher who wants to see your work turn into data that ships. You have high agency and a bias toward action.

- PhD or equivalent research experience in computer vision, multi-modal learning, machine learning, or a closely related field, with a track record of published work or shipped research

- Hands-on experience with post-training: fine-tuning, RL, evaluation design, or data curation for large models

- Strong engineering fundamentals - you write the code for your own experiments and can hand it to an engineer to productionize

- Clear written communication; you can explain a failure mode to a lab researcher and a data spec to an annotator

- Nice to have: experience at a frontier lab or as a data/evaluation partner to one; experience with vision-language models, robotics learning, or agentic coding evaluations

WHERE YOU'LL WORK

Roboflow is a fully distributed company with hubs in San Francisco, New York City, Singapore, and Brazil. Roboflow Labs works in person in San Francisco. We host full company retreats twice per year.

Whatever you call yourself: you'll make sure the right client problem becomes the right AYBI solution, and that what gets sold is what actually gets built. Not just a good proposal. • A salary between €85,000-€90,000 gross per year, based on your experience.

• 25 vacation days, the option to buy up to 10 more, local public holidays, and the option of a sabbatical up to 4 months.

• Two trips abroad a year with the whole team, plus occasional drinks and team outings.

• €500 home-office budget and a great laptop.

• A well-earned “Hey, well done Buddy!”, now and then.

• Fully remote, within the Netherlands.

About us
All Your BI is a remote-first data agency based in Rotterdam. Since 2019, we’ve grown from a boutique consultancy into an international data team of more than 60 data heroes spread across Europe. We deliver managed BI services for logistics and industrial companies, helping reduce data waste and move businesses forward. We live for the WOW moment, that sparkle in users’ eyes when they gain new insights and discover opportunities. We work according to Holacracy: little hierarchy, lots of ownership. Serious work. Serious fun.

• Lead discovery and scoping for qualified opportunities: get past the feature request to the real business problem, the outcome the client wants, and the real constraints, then turn that into a solution using AYBI's data and BI platforms, including our own accelerator tools and the Microsoft data stack.

• Own the solution behind the proposal: the approach, deliverables, assumptions, risks, team and effort. You decide when a solution is ready to sell and when architects, engineers or other specialists need to validate it first.

• Shape the commercial case together with Sales, including the business case, the story and the pricing assumptions. Sales owns negotiation and closing; you own the credibility of what's underneath it. You'll also lead presentations, workshops and demos, explaining complex data work clearly to business and technical stakeholders.

• Own delivery readiness before AYBI commits: make sure scope, capacity, assumptions, responsibilities and what "done" actually looks like are understood by both sides. Build a proper handover for every signed deal and stay involved through the first 30 days to catch gaps before they turn into problems.

• Close the loop after the sale. Compare what was scoped against what the delivery team actually encountered, spot where margin or expectations slipped, and turn that into better proposals, playbooks and standards for next time.

• Keep improving the full process, from discovery through handover, using AI where it genuinely improves speed or quality. Track proposal turnaround, win rate, scope changes after signature and handover issues during the first 30 days.

title: Sr. Manager, Global Procurement (Jewelry)
description:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come - and return - to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way - at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

• We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose - soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price - we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.

• Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.

• Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE
Sr. Manager, Global Procurement (Jewelry)
We are seeking an exceptional Sr. Manager, Global Procurement (Jewelry) to own and drive cost structures and savings. This role is critical to our goal of delivering the highest quality products, at radically low prices, done right. Reporting to the Head of Procurement, the ideal candidate will leverage their deep expertise in commodity costing, clean sheet, manufacturing excellence & efficiency (consumption,C&M excellence), harvest timing, raw material availability to craft a competitive costing environment where major T1 and T2 suppliers are being challenged to provide transparent and competitive pricing to achieve a win win supply chain for both Quince and our partners.
Success in this role means achieving product cost at or near should-costing, securing supply continuity, and contributing to product excellence by aligning material procurement processes with the company’s innovation and sustainability goals. This role offers the opportunity to make a significant impact on our business, contribute to company growth, and shape the future of our global sourcing strategy.

Procurement Category Strategy: Define and execute the commercial roadmap and vendor distribution strategy for assigned categories to improve margins as Quince scales. Establish short- and long-term procurement targets aligned to business growth.

• Consistently deliver exceptional product cost without sacrificing product quality or ESG considerations, including Procurement.

• Partner with the technology team to embed procurement capabilities and playbook into the Vendor Portal and Product Catalog tools.

• Identify and deliver 700 bps product
